line.name: Omar Ortez Originals
line.description: UNRESOLVED CONFLICT - flagging rather than guessing: most current major retailers (Cigars International, Famous Smoke, JR Cigars, Mike's Cigars, Atlantic Cigar, CigarPlace) sell 'Omar Ortez Originals' as its own distinct line, separate from 'Omar Ortez Connecticut' and 'Omar Ortez Maduro.' However, at least one retailer (bestcigarprices.com) lists a product called 'Omar Ortez Originals Toro Maduro,' and an older 2012 review site reviewed an 'Omar Ortez Originals Honduran Maduro' - suggesting that historically, 'Maduro' may have been sold as a wrapper variant WITHIN the Originals line, later spun off (or inconsistently branded) as the standalone 'Omar Ortez Maduro' line researched separately in this batch. Modeled here as a separate line per current majority retailer convention, but this relationship should be treated as unresolved.
